title: My first itch.io release: an auto-battler where the class tree keeps branching instead of closing
author: EdgeMaster8904
selftext:
I’ve always liked games where you mix classes to find broken synergies, but a lot of them promise endless paths and quietly funnel you into a few endings. This one is my attempt at the opposite.

160+ jobs across three tiers, secret jobs from unusual combinations, and battles that play themselves so you can watch your build succeed or fall apart.

Windows, 25% off for launch week: [https://lonelysamu.itch.io/mercenaries-of-varrow](https://lonelysamu.itch.io/mercenaries-of-varrow)

I’ve set aside 15 keys for anyone here interested in helping test it. If you try it, I’d love to hear if anything feels missing, and I’d really appreciate it if you shared the synergies you find. Just comment and I’ll DM you one.

Hobby project, made with AI help. Feedback on balance is very welcome, and I’m updating it every few days.
